tokens.name: shifa-color-bg-app
tokens.usage: Page background behind the cards (cream).

tokens.name: shifa-color-bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, tables and dialogs.

tokens.name: shifa-color-bg-surface-raised
tokens.usage: A band or panel set apart inside a surface: table headers, a side panel, a selected tab.

tokens.name: shifa-color-bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Translucent scrim behind dialogs and sheets. Never under text that must be read.

tokens.name: shifa-color-text-default
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and values on every surface.

tokens.name: shifa-color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, metadata, column headers. 4.5 : 1 on the app, surface and raised backgrounds and the subtle and default selection tints; not on selection.strong.

tokens.name: shifa-color-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons of a disabled control. 3 : 1, so it is still legible; disabled is also shown by the control's state, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: shifa-color-icon-default
tokens.usage: Icon strokes next to text and in controls (Phosphor, duotone).

tokens.name: shifa-color-icon-muted
tokens.usage: Icons that only decorate a value already written in words (a field's leading icon). 3 : 1.

tokens.name: shifa-color-icon-tone-default
tokens.usage: Second tone of a duotone icon (mint). Decorative fill under the stroke; the stroke carries the contrast.

tokens.name: shifa-color-icon-tone-current
tokens.usage: Second tone of the icon of the current item only (gold): the active navigation entry, the patient in the room.

tokens.name: shifa-color-border-default
tokens.usage: Card and divider lines. Decorative: never the only cue.

tokens.name: shifa-color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning alone (input outlines): 3 : 1 on every surface.

tokens.name: shifa-color-border-focus
tokens.usage: The 2 px focus outline of every interactive element; 3 : 1 on every surface. The focus halo (shadow.focus) sits outside it.

tokens.name: shifa-color-selection-subtle
tokens.usage: A hovered row or a soft highlight.

tokens.name: shifa-color-selection-default
tokens.usage: A selected row, list item or slot.

tokens.name: shifa-color-selection-strong
tokens.usage: A selected item that is also hovered or pressed, and the range ends of a date range. Only color.text.default and color.icon.default sit on it.

tokens.name: shifa-color-nav-bg
tokens.usage: The navigation rail and the top bar (deep green).
